bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for statue of Christopher Columbus.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CHRISTOPHER COLUMBUS STATUE.

$235,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration to work in consultation with the Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board to reinstall the previously displayed Christopher Columbus statue on the State Capitol Mall.
